report_name: New White House Executive Order Modifies Cybersecurity Mandates

identities.name: White House
identities.description: Issued the executive order 'Sustaining Select Efforts to Strengthen the Nation's Cybersecurity' to amend previous cybersecurity policies for federal agencies and contractors.

identities.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
identities.description: An agency whose pilot program for a 'rules-as-code' system was extended by the new executive order. The agency's Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) remains a key compliance requirement for government contractors.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: An agency whose pilot program for a 'rules-as-code' system was extended by the new executive order.

identities.name: U.S. Federal Government Agencies
identities.description: A class of organizations directly affected by the modified implementation timelines for phishing-resistant MFA and other security controls under the new executive order.

identities.name: U.S. Government Contractors
identities.description: A class of organizations impacted by the revised software supply chain self-attestation process, which shifts from upfront artifact submission to a post-incident verification model.
